title: Create a point
preconditions: Fresh project in the matching module; default units mm, N, s.
steps: Open a sketch on XY; create a point by clicking points; finish.
expected: Entity appears, is selectable and reports 2 free DOF in the status bar.

title: Delete a point that carries constraints
preconditions: Fresh project in the matching module; default units mm, N, s.
steps: Create a point, constrain it to another entity, delete the point.
expected: Entity and every constraint that references it are removed; solver re-runs; no orphan constraints.

title: Drag an unconstrained point
preconditions: Fresh project in the matching module; default units mm, N, s.
steps: Create a point; drag a handle 25 mm in X.
expected: Entity follows the cursor live; no other entity moves.

title: Convert point to construction
preconditions: Fresh project in the matching module; default units mm, N, s.
steps: Create a point; toggle construction mode.
expected: Rendered dashed; excluded from profile loops used by Pad/Pocket; still usable by constraints.
